SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-20-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO NOV-29-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF VANDOR HILL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANA L. DE LUCIO-BROCK IS PRESENT. PARTIES REACH A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN OPEN COURT FOR $1,664.00. DEFENDANT TO PAY PLAINTIFF $200.00 A MONTH STARTING AUGUST 20, 2021, AND ON THE 20TH OF EACH MONTH THEREAFTER FOR 8+ MONTHS. DEFENDANT TO PAY PLAINTIFF EITHER BY VENMO OR PAYPAL. PROGRESS REPORT DATES ARE TO BE SET. 1ST PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR NOVEMBER 29, 2021, AT 1:30 PM. 2ND PROGRESS REPORT DATE TO BE SET IN APRIL 2022. NO APPEARANCES ARE REQUIRED IF PAYMENTS ARE BEING MADE AS AGREED AND THE MATTER WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE SET FOR A PROGRESS REPORT IN APRIL 2022. (AFTER APRIL 20, 2022) IF NO APPEARANCE IS MADE AT THE HEARING DATE IN APRIL 2022, THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
